Interface PolicyMask

All Known Implementing Classes:
PolicyMaskJson
public interface PolicyMask
A policy mask that constrains the managed policies and permission sets available to a principal, as returned by the IAM policy-mask operations.

This is a read-only response view (spec schema PolicyMask). The managedPolicies/managedPermissionSets fields are a oneOf of the literal string "none" or an array of ids, and subtract is a structured object; all three are exposed as lossless PolicyExpression values preserving whichever form was returned.
